description: Give one lease's sims back. `fast` (default) stops the app and restores its seeded data in about 2 s; `full` rebuilds each sim from the template. Use `full` after anything changed OS settings (permissions, keychain, location) or after a crash. Releasing your last lease ends the run, unless `keepRun` is true. To end a run with a result, use sim_farm_finish instead.

epoch.description: The epoch from sim_farm_acquire. A stale epoch is refused.

keepRun.description: Keep the run open to take more sims into it later.

name: sim_farm_release
